ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: pages of the Pokédex
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Catch five species the colony's Pokédex doesn't have yet.

plain.li: Half the Pokédex is question marks. I say we put five names where the question marks are, before the season's out.
Every species we catch teaches us something about this land. Five more, and we'll know it better than anyone.

warm.li: Every Pokémon out there is a friend we haven't met. Let's meet five of them.

blunt.li: Five new species. Belts on, everybody.

cheerful.li: A Pokédex project. I'll make a chart, with little drawings!

gloomy.li: If we don't catch them now, some of them we'll never see again. Five, at least.

cold.li: Every blank page in the Pokédex is a creature out there we don't understand yet. Five species is a reasonable target.

plain.li: Five new pages in the Pokédex. Everyone signed the margin.

cheerful.li: Five, and the chart is full. I need a bigger chart!

cold.li: Five species added, as planned. The next five will be harder.
